```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
source("../scripts/ggprob.R")
```

X = no. of heads in 3 coin flips

- `dbinom()`

```{r}
dbinom(2, 3, 0.5)
choose(3, 2)*(0.5)^2*(1-0.5)^1

dbinom(0:3, 3, 0.5) # binomial dist is symmetric (or bell shaped) when p is close to 0.5
```

- `pbinom()`: 

By default,
$$P(X \le q) = \sum_{i=0}^q P(X = i)$$

If we use the argument, `lower.tail = F`, then pbinom() gives you the prob to the right of a point.

$$P(X > q) = \sum_{i=q+1}^{\inf} P(X = i)$$


```{r}
dbinom(0:3, 3, 0.5)
```

```{r}
pbinom(2, 3, 0.5) # P(X=0)+P(X=1)+P(X=2)

0.125 + 0.375 + 0.375

pbinom(2, 3, 0.5, lower.tail = F) # P(X > 2) = P(X = 3)

1 - pbinom(2, 3, 0.5)

gbinom(3, 0.5) +
  geom_binom_density(3, 0.5, a = 0, b = 2, color = "red")
```

```{r}
#P(X>=2)

pbinom(1, 3, 0.5, lower.tail = F) # P(X >= q), pbinom(q-1, n, p, lower.tail = F)
```



- `qbinom()`: gives the point that covers a (atleast) certain prob `p` to the left (by default) or to the right (using the `lower.tail = F`) 

```{r}
qbinom(0.5, 3, 0.5)

gbinom(3, 0.5)

dbinom(0:3, 3, 0.5)
```


```{r}
qbinom(0.7, 3, 0.5) # 70th percentile

0.125 + 0.375 + 0.375
0.125 + 0.375

qbinom(seq(0.5, 0.9, by = 0.05), 3, 0.5) # all the percentiles between 0.5 and 0.875 will return 2, anything below or above that range will give 1 and 3 respectively. 
```


```{r}
gbinom(2000, 0.01)
```

$$n*p*(1-p) \ge 10$$
